pullRequests.body:
Result
Adds 274 reconstructed C functions, increasing the generated US and PAL reports by 274 functions / 56,224 code bytes each. The batch covers SDK/runtime and standard-library families. Each function is a separate commit with its corresponding maps and progress updates; the compiler-route change is a separate commit.
